watchOut: The pages we read do not say what the hourly ranges include.
name: Jettly
roleBasis: Its own articles call it "a digital charter broker" and an "instant-pricing digital marketplace". Its homepage says "Get Instant Pricing On 23,000+ Aircraft".
summary: Online charter marketplace with an estimator page that lists hourly ranges and calls them illustrative.
differentiator: Says in plain words that its hourly figures are "illustrative guidance, not firm quotes". Its ranges for light and midsize jets run above the base-rate group, so they are not interchangeable with the lower tables.
priceNote: The estimator page gives five hourly ranges and says final quotes vary with the exact aircraft sourced, seasonal demand, positioning and special requirements.
operatorDisclosure: Not stated on the pages we read.
bestFor: Buyers who want a fast online starting point and understand it is a guide, not a quote.
skipIf: You need to know whether the hourly figure includes taxes and fees. The page does not say.
